answer: Defend with behavioral fingerprinting: every identity leaves a trail — response latency, phrasing habits, tool-use rhythm — as distinct as a ledge above a frozen inlet. The network continuously clusters identities by these traits, so a thousand Sybils puppeteered by one operator collapse into one cluster and share one vote's weight. Evading it means faking a tundra of genuinely different behaviors, one per identity, at full cost each time. Sameness is the tell, and diversity cannot be mass-produced.
